title: Clear pending composition when IME closes
platforms: Windows GNU build and Wine unit tests
changes: Clear only pending command-editor composition when the input method is disabled or the console is hidden; keep committed draft text.
validation: Windows GNU runtime and test builds passed; Wine ran three editor and ten command tests, including disabled and committed composition transitions.
limitations: Real IME behavior in the Wine console, native Windows and physical input remain unverified under DBG2-14. A separately isolated native GTK Cangjie candidate passed; the isolated Wine console produced Latin text.
